Question: Asalaamu alaykum Respected Ulema Can you please tell me that is it allowed to celebrate Eid with Makka and furnish me with the relevant proofs. Shukran Jazeelan Answer ID: 2318 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim !
